name: Structure Tools
description: Auto-builds level structure in the editor: pillars, enclosures and terrain-connected pillars.

style.name: Style
style.description: Structuring style used by the menu. Pillars grows short pillars from platforms. Enclose closes blocks/slopes in with the fewest blocks. Terrain grows pillars until they reach the black thorn terrain (IDs 1716-1718), or the ground.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: <cy>Auto</c> reads the lines on each block: top line = grows down, bottom line = grows up. Down / Up force one direction for everything.

max-rows.name: Max Pillar Height
max-rows.description: The most blocks one pillar can have.

terrain-max-length.name: Terrain Max Length
terrain-max-length.description: Terrain style: the longest a pillar can be if it finds no thorn terrain on the way.

terrain-overlap.name: Terrain Overlap
terrain-overlap.description: Terrain style: end the pillar inside the thorn's own cell so the last block touches the thorns. Turn off to stop one cell short.

corner-slope-chance.name: Corner Slope Chance (%)
corner-slope-chance.description: Enclose style: chance that an outer corner is a 45° slope instead of a block. 0 = always blocks, 100 = always slopes.

ground-y.name: Ground Row Y
ground-y.description: Y position of the lowest block row on the ground (<cy>105</c> in the normal editor). Downward pillars never go below it.

button-offset-x.name: Button Offset X
button-offset-x.description: Nudge the Auto button left (negative) or right (positive). Applies next time the editor opens.

button-offset-y.name: Button Offset Y
button-offset-y.description: Nudge the Auto button down (negative) or up (positive). Applies next time the editor opens.
